sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: FRET dose-response assay in HEK293T cells: HaloTag-CCKBR showed dose-dependent responses to both MF-8 (n=4) and CCK8s (n=5), confirming surface display and preserved agonist-driven signaling.
sites.rationale: The topology assigns EC1 to residues 1–54 with no signal peptide, so the extracellular N-terminus is the only surface terminus available for a prepend tag. The hGH signal in the construct is an exogenous trafficking device that is cleaved post-translationally, placing HaloTag at the extracellular face before CCKBR Met-1. Python verification confirms residue 1 = M and the 54-residue EC1 span provides ample clearance (54 aa) from TM1 at residue 55, well above the 3-residue minimum. Functional FRET signaling with two agonists at the tagged receptor establishes both surface display and preserved receptor function. Full-length human CCKBR cloned into pcDNA3.1(+) with an hGH signal sequence followed by HaloTag before the receptor sequence (residue 1 = M); expressed in HEK293T cells and labeled with Fluo-Halo for surface FRET detection. The hGH signal drives secretory trafficking and is cleaved, leaving HaloTag as the extracellular N-terminal domain immediately before CCKBR residue 1. No signal peptide is encoded in the canonical CCKBR sequence itself (EC1 begins at residue 1), so the junction is unambiguously a prepend at position 0.

sources.claim: E The dose-dependent response curve of MF-8 (red, n = 4) and CCK8s (blue, n = 5) at 293T cells expressing transfected HaloTag-CCKBR in the FRET assay.

literature_notes: L1–L4 all describe the same HaloTag-CCKBR construct and the same N-terminal junction (insert_after_residue=0); L2 was chosen as the primary clip because it contains both the construct description and the functional FRET result. L5 independently corroborates an N-terminal epitope tag (FLAG) at the identical junction in a 215-GPCR surface-expression library, but pins no different residue and therefore does not constitute a separate site. The C-terminal 1D4 tag in L5 is placed after residue 447, which falls within IC4 (394–447, intracellular C-terminus) and is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line reports any insertion in ECL1 (118–128), ECL2 (192–219), or ECL3 (355–369) of CCKBR or a close ortholog, so no internal sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal 1D4 tag placed after the last residue (G447) of CCKBR; the C-terminus falls within IC4 (394–447, intracellular), making this an intracellular label, not a surface tag.
